utsu.char: The slim adult male dual swordsman Utsu keeps the EXACT original right-facing three-quarter ready stance. He has tousled short dark brown hair, a pale tired youthful masculine face, focused gray eyes, a worn short navy half-cape, ivory split tunic, dark trousers, crossed brown leather straps and asymmetric silver armor. He holds exactly TWO slender straight steel swords, ONE firmly gripped in each gloved hand: the forward sword guards diagonally upward toward screen right, the rear sword stays lowered diagonally backward toward screen left. Both guards, grips and hands keep their original anatomical connections.
utsu.motion: Like an agile fighting-game dual swordsman, he repeats a connected rhythmic ready bounce in place: both knees clearly flex and straighten, his hips and torso lower then rise together, and his shoulders, neck, head, elbows and wrists follow naturally as one connected body. The restrained knee spring is visibly readable, without deep squatting or pitching his torso. His two hands and swords rise and settle gently with the shoulders while keeping their different guard heights. Preserve his original slight forward inclination and quiet unsmiling alert expression, with no additional hunching. He is ready to chain the first cut into the second, but never performs a slash or swings either sword during this idle.
utsu.sway: His short hair tips, navy cape edges and ivory waist panels sway with a slight natural delay and settle with his body. BOTH swords remain completely straight and rigid with constant length and thickness; their blades, guards and pommels move as intact rigid objects attached to the hands. Both sword tips remain inside the image throughout. No fire, magic, glow, smoke or slash trails.
utsu.neg: bending sword, flexible blade, rubber weapon, changing sword length, melting guard, extra sword, missing sword, detached handle, hand sliding on grip, crossed hands, swinging sword, attacking, slashing, spinning, deep squat, extreme bounce, hunching further forward, head turning, smiling, weapon leaving frame
utsu.note: 2026-10-27 ユーザーがAを選択しゲーム反映を依頼。seed 2022を6コマで継ぎ目補修した24コマ・1.50秒の双剣待機をidle_loop/utsuへ導入。足元926固定、緑0、継ぎ目0.84x。B（seed 5055・37コマ）は比較用として保存。記録はdesign/art/utsu/idle-loop-v1/notes.md。

_readme: ④b（キャラごとの文）。組み立ては idle_loop.py の compose(): HEAD + char + motion + 共通の縛り（sway を含む）。neg は共通の負のプロンプトの後ろに足す。新しいキャラは既存の項目を写して char / motion / sway を書き換える。motion には『膝がはっきり曲がって伸びる・弾む』を必ず入れる（『ゆっくり重く』『わずかに』と書くと止まる）。

hagi.char: The agile young adult female reaper Hagi is SILENTLY waiting in a fighting game guard stance, facing right at the same three-quarter angle. Her body actively bobs through the knees; she is not a still mannequin with moving clothes. Her original confident half-smile stays unchanged: lips and jaw keep exactly the same shape and the same small opening throughout, no speech or mouth animation. She has a short charcoal-black bob and a thin crimson side braid. Preserve the exact black, muted crimson, gray and gold costume, opaque short skirt with long asymmetric cloth tails, one black thigh-high stocking and black gold-trimmed boots. BOTH hands keep firmly closed around ONE straight black scythe shaft in front of her: lower hand at screen left beside her hip, upper hand at screen right beside her shoulder, thumbs opposed to curled fingers. The huge clean silver crescent blade remains above and to screen right, with exactly ONE large oval hole in the gold root and three narrow dark engraved grooves.
hagi.motion: A clearly visible FULL-BODY springy fighting game idle animation. Repeat two or three distinct rhythmic guard bounces: BOTH knees visibly flex deeper, the PELVIS and WAIST lower by about a palm width, the CHEST, SHOULDERS and HEAD travel downward together with the pelvis, then her legs extend back to the original ready stance and the entire connected body rises again. The highest position is the original stance; each bounce sinks below it, never rising above it. The body movement is unmistakable even if the loose cloth were hidden. Her neck follows her torso and her chin stays level, not nodding. Both soles remain planted in their exact original positions while the knees bend; never translate a stiff whole body or float the feet. Her back stays straight, chest lifted and gaze forward. Both gripping arms and the rigid scythe rise and fall WITH her moving shoulders and pelvis, maintaining the same grip spacing. Keep the same confident half-smile and unchanged lips through every bounce.
hagi.sway: Short bob tips, crimson braid, loose sleeve ends and long cloth tails make restrained secondary follow-through AFTER the moving body, then settle on each beat; no independent continuous wind. The torso, pelvis and knees are the primary movement, never only fluttering clothes. The opaque skirt keeps the same length and coverage. Scythe shaft and blade remain perfectly rigid, constant in length and shape with the single large oval hole. Fingers stay firmly wrapped around the shaft. No speaking, no lip sync, no chewing, no mouth opening and closing, no weapon flourish, no attack, no bells, no added chains, no blood, no fire, no smoke, no souls, no particles, no glow.

hagi.note: 2026-10-26 ユーザーが身体の動きと口元を修正したv2-Bのゲーム適用を依頼し、hagi_body_v2_s3033_finalを採用。48コマ・16fps・crossfade6・640x960、生成連番の全画素を保って配置。Hagiの一時停止に待機の子ノードも追従する修正を追加。IdleLoopCheck/PortraitStateCheck/FireCheck/MovementPortraitCheck/HagiPresentationCheckと本編Vulkan画面で確認。記録はdesign/art/hagi/idle-loop-v2/integration.json。

rica.char: The slender adult female elf gravekeeper Rica keeps the exact same right-facing three-quarter planted ready stance with softly bent knees. She has silver-white hair with ONE thick braid draped on SCREEN RIGHT, long pointed ears, pale skin and calm ice-blue eyes. She wears a charcoal hood-down long cloak, a dark teal high-neck long-sleeved dress, a long tan canvas work apron with one flat pocket and repair stitches, a brown belt and pouch, cemetery keys, brown fingerless gloves, black stockings and brown cuffed work boots. She holds ONE ordinary gravedigger shovel diagonally across her body: the rear hand at screen left grips near its D handle beside her hip, and the forward hand at screen right supports the middle of the wooden shaft from underneath, with one thumb opposed to four fingers. The pointed metal spade stays low in front toward screen right.
rica.motion: Like a patient fighting game character waiting in guard, she repeats a steady measured rhythmic springy breathing cycle in place: her knees clearly flex and straighten within a shallow ready stance, her hips and torso sink and recover together, and her shoulders and both supported forearms rise and settle as one connected body. She keeps the same lightly forward ready lean, a level chin and quiet focused gaze toward the opponent. Her head and neck naturally follow her torso without nodding. Both hands maintain their exact grips and spacing, and the supported shovel moves with her arms as one rigid object, never swung independently. Repeat the same restrained ready-guard cycle several times, never lowering into a deep squat or changing stance.
rica.sway: Her single silver braid on screen right, short hair tips, charcoal cloak and long apron and dress hems softly follow through after the body and settle each cycle. The shovel D handle, straight wooden shaft, metal socket, central blade rib and pointed tip remain rigid and collinear, with constant shape, length and blade size. Fingers stay attached and wrapped around the handle, and the braid stays on screen right. No digging, no attack, no shovel flourish, no ghosts, no floating souls, no magic, no smoke, no particles, no glow.
rica.neg: deep squatting, extreme bounce, standing rigidly upright, widening stance, leaning farther forward, hunched back, bowing head, nodding, changing grip, hand sliding along shaft, missing thumb, extra fingertips, detached fingers, rubber shovel, curved shovel shaft, bent spade blade, twisting blade, shrinking shovel, changing D handle, digging, shovel swing, attacking, double braids, braid on screen left, changing apron, rising cloak hood, ghosts, souls, magic effects

hibi.sway: Her short hair tips and tattered navy, ivory and burgundy cloth softly follow through with the breathing and settle. gald_breath_v2.full: A hand-drawn 2D anime game animation of a disciplined armored knight breathing in a steady defensive guard. The fully closed helmet, battered ivory-white plate armor with dark red cracks, pointed kite shield and straight sword stay faithful to the reference image. He remains in the same broad planted right-facing stance throughout. The animation is a small repeated breathing cycle: his chest expands outward on the inhale and settles inward on the exhale, the shoulder plates gently settle with the breath, and the loose torn waist cloth softly sways and settles. He completes the whole inhale and exhale and returns to the same resting guard, repeating this breathing cycle several times with an even unhurried rhythm. His neck remains upright and his helmet stays level and steady, watching the opponent without nodding. His knees remain at the same bent angle, holding a stable height. Both forearms hold a steady guard throughout: the right hand stays low by his hip, the sword stays at the same low diagonal angle with the tip down and right; the left forearm keeps the shield upright at the same height. The weapons are supported, not swung or lifted. The sword and shield are rigid and keep their original shape and length. Both feet stay flat in exactly the same spots. Same helmet, same costume, same colors, same silhouette and proportions. Fixed camera, full body always visible, flat plain green background. Only breathing and the cloth's soft secondary motion, no attack, no flourish, no magic effects.
gald_breath_v2.neg: head bobbing, nodding, head shaking, helmet bouncing, squatting, bending and straightening knees, bouncing body, vertical bobbing, lifting sword, raising sword, lowering sword, sword swing, sword flourish, changing sword angle, shield bash, raising shield, bending weapon, hunched back, slouching, bowing head, face visible through helmet, frozen image
gald_breath_v2.note: 2026-10-16 v2の固定レイヤー仕上げも不採用。ユーザーは顔や腕の小さな動きを許容し、全身の連動を求めている。固定画像を上貼りしたら首が切れたように見えた。v3はv1の全身運動を一体に30% / 45%へ縮小して2秒へ整える。design/art/gald/idle-loop-v3/ のComfyUIワークフローとVPScaleIdleMotionを使い、剣・盾は動かしながら形を維持する。2026-10-17、兜・剣周りを修正したv4 Aを採用（galdのadopted参照）。

ere.char: The adult wandering female bard Ere waits facing right in the exact original three-quarter stance. She has a thick long chestnut braid, a small black embroidered cap, a long sheer black veil, ivory puff sleeves, layered black and burgundy skirts, gold star ornaments and brown boots. She holds ONE wooden pear-shaped lute firmly against her chest, its short straight neck pointing up and right: left fingers stay on the frets and the right hand rests over the strings at the round rosette. Preserve the exact mature face, calm attentive expression, lute outline, rosette and straight parallel strings.
ere.motion: A continuous connected full-body fighting-game idle: repeat two or three graceful rhythmic guard bounces. Both knees clearly flex and straighten; the pelvis lowers and rises, with chest, shoulders and head following together. Keep an elegant upright back, chest lifted and chin level, never hunching over the instrument. The breathing and knee motion are visible but restrained, approximately a small hand-width in total. Her forearms and the rigid lute follow her shoulders gently. The right fingers softly prepare the strings without a broad performance strum; the left hand maintains its grip on the same frets.
ere.sway: The braid, veil, loose ivory sleeves, skirt hems, burgundy lute ribbon and small gold charms gently lag behind the connected body motion, sway and settle. The lute is rigid: never bend, stretch or inflate its wooden body, neck, strings or tuning pegs. Do not detach the neck, do not change the finger count. No music notes, no magic, no glow, no particles, no smoke. Her lips keep the original shape; she is waiting rather than actively singing.

ere_singing.full: A 2D anime game bard performing her lament skill, a continuous repeating musical performance animation. The adult female bard Ere keeps the exact original right-facing three-quarter pose, eyes softly closed and chin lifted as she sings with the original narrow open mouth. Preserve her chestnut braid, embroidered black cap and veil, ivory sleeves, burgundy and black layered skirt, star jewelry and brown boots. She holds ONE wooden pear-shaped lute across her chest; her left hand stays wrapped around the SAME upper frets and the right wrist performs two or three CLEAR visible down-up strumming gestures across the strings over the rosette. Her right elbow opens, the wrist sweeps down across the strings and returns; the hand does NOT leave the wooden soundboard area. Her chest expands and rises on the musical phrase, shoulders and lute rise together, then her knees flex gently and the full body settles before the next phrase. A graceful confident connected performance, not an idle mannequin, not a dancing spin. The instrument moves as ONE RIGID object following the torso and arms. The pear body, rosette, straight neck, straight parallel strings and tuning pegs never change shape or length. The braid, veil, sleeve cuffs, skirt hems, gold chains and lute ribbon follow the musical upper-body movement with soft natural delay. Both boots remain firmly planted at the exact same ground positions. No steps, no jumping, no turning, no forward travel. Keep her eyes closed and mouth small throughout, no exaggerated lip sync. Same face, same costume and colors. No floating music notes, no magical effects, no glow, no particles: the game adds the gift effect later. Fixed camera, no zoom, full body and both boots always visible, plain solid green background.
